name: @dnc/contracts
description: Zod schemas for everything crossing a network boundary, plus the locked RSVP domain vocabulary. Source-only: consumed by Turbopack, Metro and vite-node, never executed as raw Node ESM, so it is deliberately not declared "type": "module" — that would make TypeScript's nodenext mode demand .js specifiers that Turbopack and Metro cannot resolve back to .ts.
